scope: CVG-004 bounded manual advance-payment issuance and append-only compensation

criteria.description: Authenticated billing.manage commands validate exact BRL cents, bounded text, UUIDs, exact payload fields, idempotency and malformed encoded paths before writing.
criteria.limitations: Only manual issuance and append-only compensation are in scope; no cancellation, refund, reversal or settlement semantics are asserted.

criteria.description: The repository uses the existing tenant unit of work, requires an active transaction, derives tenant/actor identity server-side and persists exact ledger facts with account-scoped idempotency.
criteria.limitations: Evidence is local and disposable; target transaction settings, grants and migration execution remain unverified.

criteria.description: Issuance and compensation append transaction-scoped audit/outbox events, preserve immutability, reject over-allocation and enforce tenant/account isolation through the canonical database rail.
criteria.limitations: The PostgreSQL proof is a fresh local database and does not certify production backup/restore, RTO/RPO or target operations.

criteria.description: Finance > Pagamento Antecipado consumes persisted canonical summaries, exposes explicit loading/empty/error/retry feedback and supports bounded issue/compensation commands without synthetic owner credit balance state.
criteria.limitations: No provider, bank, cash, PIX, accounting or target-environment UX acceptance is asserted.

criteria.description: Full workspace quality gates, official coverage, build, security and structural controls pass after the bounded write implementation.
criteria.limitations: Repository-local controls do not prove full Vetus parity, external homologation, accessibility, remote CI, operations or release acceptance.

gaps: Cancellation, refund, reversal, cash/bank/PIX, accounting-journal and receivable-settlement lifecycle remain outside this bounded gate.
Providers, Live Lab, Vetus import, distributed worker failure/observability, remaining reports, target RLS/restore/RTO-RPO, remote CI, accessibility, operations and release remain open.

authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded manual advance-payment issuance and append-only compensation
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation and local/disposable PostgreSQL, API and SPA verification using the existing 0148 ledger. Require billing.manage, exact BRL cents, tenant UoW/idempotency, transaction-scoped audit/outbox and RLS. Exclude cash/journal/receivable links, refund/cancellation, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before adding refund/cancellation/reversal, cash/bank/PIX/receivable/journal integration, backfill, provider, target operation, production/deployment action or release acceptance.

next_action: Keep CVG-004 and the global program IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL. Select the next separately authorized gap; do not promote this bounded result to full Vetus parity, enterprise readiness or release.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to advance-payment persistence, allocation semantics, idempotency, audit/outbox or finance authorization
Any cancellation, refund, reversal, cash/bank/PIX, receivable or accounting-journal integration
Any provider, target, production, deployment or release expansion
